text_block_list.text: One day, while walking around the academy—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Aaah~ A mournful waltz~~♪
A tragedy that just won't stick in my head~~♪

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
A silent grand piano~~♪
The reality of problems I can't solve~~♪
choice_data_list: You seem to have something on your mind.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer.
Did my musica reach you?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Yes, a song lamenting that studying just won't stick!
Oh, why, oh why is it so~~♪

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I made plans to hang out with Nature-san
and the other girls tomorrow, but—

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text: That will be all for today's class.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Benissimo!
Now, let us play a melody of freedom!"

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Also, we'll have a short quiz tomorrow.
Anyone who gets a failing mark will have to take remedial classes, understand?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Doloroso!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
And so, I tried to focus on my studies,
but looking at the textbook, all that came to mind were musical notes.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: I was starting to think that taking supplementary lessons might actually be a more fitting way of life for me.
choice_data_list: In other words, you want to give up?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah... But right at that moment,
it started ringing in my head.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"The joyous melody of the session
I'll be playing with my friends tomorrow!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Jamming with a friend creates an irreplaceable Melodia!
It unlocks infinite possibilities! That's why—"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: I shall seal away music!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I entrust all my instruments to you!
Watch me as I pour everything I have into my studies!

Having shoved the instrument into my hands,
she turned back to face her desk.
...However—
(Tap♪ Tap-tap-tap♪)
choice_data_list: Are you tapping out a rhythm with your pen?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: No?! How could this be?!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: "...To think that separating myself from music would prove even more impossible than my studies..."
Sounds of Earth was looking unusually downcast. But that was only proof of just how much she treasured her sessions with her friends.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: What's this? You're struggling with your studies?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Nature-san? And... everyone else too!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
If it's us, we'll help as much as you need.
Leave it all to us, boom!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I shall manage the study workflow.
It will certainly be far more efficient than proceeding blindly.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I'll leave the studying to everyone else!
Leave the cheering to Turbo!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Then I'll think up a reaction for when Earth-san
successfully finishes her test!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Trainer, what is this?!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ...!? Benissssssimo!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, in a session, we can play music
that could never be created alone.
It unlocks infinite possibilities...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Forza, iniziamo la sessione!!

The next day after school, I spotted
Sounds of Earth by the school gate.
choice_data_list: Are you meeting up with everyone?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Sì! My heart was beating prestissimo, so I ended up arriving early.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"And once again, let me thank you as well, Trainer!
Grazie mille!!"
choice_data_list: If you ever need help, I'll jam with you anytime!
Let's keep up with our studies on a regular basis too!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: As reassuring as a double bass!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Then let's take advantage of this waiting time
and hold a jam session right away!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Thirty minutes until our appointment!
Come along with me, amico!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Thirty minutes until our appointment!
Come along with me, amica!

And so, I ended up helping
Sounds of Earth kill some time.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Doloroso...
After conquering my studies, I must face even more?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Musica is all about moving up and down the scale!
Playing the same note over and over is just boring!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Playâª Raceâª Playâª Raceâª
Raceâª Raceâª Playâª Playâª Studyâª
See? Perfectly balanced, right?
"Sounds of Earth tried to push through with sheer vibes despite the wildly off-balance state."
